title: Generate images from text

body.text: Grok can generate images from a description. Same principle as other image tools: state the
clearly. The more concrete your description, the closer the image matches what you want.

example: Generate an image: a cute robot watering plants in a garden in the morning, 3D cartoon style, bright colors

title: Analyze and summarize long content

body.text: Use Grok to summarize articles, analyze data, or help draft writing like any chatbot. The difference is it can weave in current information, making it great for research that needs both knowledge and the latest news.

example: Analyze how this year's EV trend affects the charging-station business, based on the latest data.

question: What's the principle of good image generation?

options.text: State the subject + details + style clearly

question: How is Grok different from other chatbots for research?

options.text: It can weave current information into existing knowledge
